prior_cold_entry_audit.scope: failure in inherited V56 guard constructor before original V54 constructor, __enter__, CUDA initialization or Predictor; original failure is not reclassified

rejected_preparation.reason: Frozen CPU import verification rejected the original metric_vendor/__init__.py: the package documentation initializer was missing from the allowed-source manifest. The pure program-tokenization module also needs its original PROVENANCE-bound SHA explicitly registered.

measurement_policy.A: one registered statically compliant submit or nonterminal action
measurement_policy.EOS: only the originally generated final stop token, not a synthetically appended token
measurement_policy.action_structure: native envelope, action name and JSON syntax including program string boundary quotes
measurement_policy.boundary_mixed: a saved BPE token intersects more than one byte group; never attributed exclusively to syntax or content
measurement_policy.post_action_whitespace: actual trailing whitespace after the single native envelope
measurement_policy.pre_action_text: all actual UTF-8 bytes preceding first valid native envelope
measurement_policy.probability: unmodified full-vocabulary float32 log_softmax; no sampling warp, temperature or vocabulary restriction
measurement_policy.program_parameter_content: bytes inside the original JSON program string, including literal JSON escapes
measurement_policy.sequence_and_group_aggregation: saved per-token logp; each group's NLL sum/count, null mean if count=0
measurement_policy.teacher_forcing: original hP plus original yP prefix; never exposed to free generation
measurement_policy.token_byte_mapping: Qwen ByteLevel vocabulary bytes; added token literal UTF-8; exact raw-response reconstruction required
measurement_policy.token_positions: zero-based positions in original raw_generated_token_ids, including actual final EOS

scientific_contract.probability: raw full vocabulary logits float32 log_softmax; chunks of 64 positions
scientific_contract.targets: actual saved parent response tokens including actual EOS
